تستنظروا (form X)
# تَسْتَنْظِرُوا (tastanẓirū) /tas.tan.ðˤi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَنْظَرَ (istanẓara)
# تُسْتَنْظَرُوا (tustanẓarū) /tus.tan.ðˤa.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَنْظَرَ (istanẓara)
